in: The release steps are one tag the build two upload the notes three email the team
expect_rules:
The release steps are:
1. Tag the build
2. Upload the notes
3. Email the team
note: Y4-A: list detection at the SHIPPED level. A fresh install now reaches the list renderer; before Y4-A this whole rule was unreachable out of the box.

in: ship it on Friday comma then tell the team period
expect_rules: ship it on Friday, then tell the team.
note: Y4-A: apply_spoken_marks punctuation-by-name at the shipped level. At "light" the words "comma" and "period" were pasted verbatim.

in: did the build go green question mark
note: Y4-A: the question mark by name, at the shipped level, in the surface where it is dictated most.

in: she said quotation mark ship it quotation mark today
note: Y4-A: the PAIRING case — MarkKind::Quote alternates open/close, so two spoken names must wrap the span, not emit two identical glyphs.

in: call the vendor new line then update the sheet
expect_rules:
call the vendor
then update the sheet
note: Y4-A: the "new line" command at the shipped level. One break, not a paragraph.

in: the migration landed last night new paragraph next I want to talk about pricing
expect_rules:
the migration landed last night

next I want to talk about pricing
note: Y4-A: R12's rules-owned half. The LLM infers paragraph breaks (c01, level high); the SPOKEN command makes one with no model at all, and that is what a fresh install gets.

in: hey jordan quick update the build is green i pushed the fix can you review before standup
expect_rules:
Hey jordan,

Quick update the build is green i pushed the fix can you review before standup
note: Y4-A: same utterance as c03, at the SHIPPED level instead of "high" — format_email_shape is rules-owned and needs no model, so it must be proven where the product actually runs it.

in: the numbers are attached and I will send the deck tomorrow thanks
expect_rules:
the numbers are attached and I will send the deck tomorrow

Thanks,
note: Y4-A: the sign-off half of R13 at the shipped level. The sign-off is MOVED to its own line, never invented.

in: the deck is ready for review.
expect_rules: the deck is ready for review
note: Y4-A: the tone-dialled trailing period at the shipped level. Pairs with d10 — same words, same surface, tone dial only.

in: the deck is ready for review.
expect_rules: the deck is ready for review.
note: Y4-A: the formal half of the d09 pair. Formal keeps the full stop; the dial touches shape only, never a word.
